rect.style: stroke-width: 1.26; stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; fill: #F3F6F8;

g.text: Days from nearest local full moon
Source: Baird et al. (2021), Coral Spawning Database v1. Natural-reef records; one count per genus, subsite and date.
Ridges use a three-day circular smoother; percentages use unsmoothed counts. Coverage differs among locations.
The window differs among coral genera; a single average would conceal those differences.
Recorded spawning is concentrated after full moon
